baseline_models.focus_anchor: The seeing verb, the clause identifying what was sent down as truth, and the following guidance predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: Received knowledge enables recognition rather than mere assent: the delivered disclosure is identified with stable reality and that same disclosure functions as a gentle guide onto a straight route characterized by strength and praiseworthiness.

activation_trace.role: Sensory or inward sight supplies the recognizing act, making the recipients witnesses rather than repeaters of a claim.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic condition by which the sent object becomes manifest.
Caused descent and delivery supply the movement by which the disclosure reaches its human addressee.
Stable correspondence against falsehood supplies the criterion recognized in the delivered disclosure.
Gentle indication toward truth and a road supplies the disclosure's active function after recognition.
A straight road supplies the traversable form taken by guidance.
Unsubdued strength and honor characterize the route's owner and exclude a path founded on humiliation.
Abundant praiseworthy qualities characterize the route's owner and make its destination normatively attractive.

changed_reading.before: People with knowledge judge a revealed proposition to be true and morally instructive.
changed_reading.after: Those made capable of knowing witness the delivered disclosure as reality, and the disclosure itself continues the act by conducting them onto a traversable divine route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from knowledge through truth and guidance to path in focus words 4, 11, 12, and 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge can be read as capacity to detect a distinguishing mark; truth is what fits its proper joint or place; guidance then establishes direction. Recognition therefore occurs through a convergence of marking, exact fit, and orientation rather than through an unsupported label.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing trace that guides toward its object turns knowledge into waymark literacy.
A joint or receptacle matching its proper place supplies the diagnostic image of truth as exact fit.
Direction, manner, and intended course convert recognized fit into orientation.
The straight road gathers the detected marks and direction into one continuous course.
A praiseworthy culmination supplies a route-end by which the course can also be evaluated.

changed_reading.before: Truth is an abstract property of the message and guidance is advice added afterward.
changed_reading.after: The knowledgeable recognize the disclosure by its marks and exact fit, while guidance is the disclosed pattern becoming a coherent direction toward a praiseworthy culmination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive reception of knowledge, the passive delivery from the Lord, and the guidance predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two receptions converge: people are given knowledge and the disclosure is delivered to the addressee. Lordly nurture brings both knower and message toward completion, so guidance can be carried as a strengthening gift rather than owned as an intellectual achievement.

activation_trace.role: Giving and bringing supply the receptive posture of those endowed with knowledge.
Delivery from above supplies a second reception, pairing the gifted knower with the gifted disclosure.
Gradual nurture, repair, and completion supply the formative relation joining recipient and disclosure.
A gracious gift sent toward one held in regard supplies an exploratory image for guidance as relational bestowal.
Strengthening one thing by another supplies the result of the paired gifts.
Being found praiseworthy after experience makes lived traversal, not possession alone, the gift's test.

changed_reading.before: The knowledgeable are a self-established expert class evaluating revelation from outside.
changed_reading.after: Knowledgeable recipients and delivered revelation are mutually fitted gifts under lordly formation; their knowledge appears in being strengthened into praiseworthy traversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired motions of entering and leaving, descending and ascending make the focus descent one operation in a larger traffic across boundaries. The focus then turns vertical delivery into horizontal conduct: what arrives from the Lord becomes a route for the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery anchor the model in the focus disclosure's arrival.
Gentle direction toward a road supplies the conversion from arrival to conduct.
Entry into an interior supplies one boundary-crossing pole of the contextual motion system.
Passage outward supplies the counter-pole to entry and makes directionality reversible rather than static.
Descent and settling supply the context's direct spatial counterpart to the focus delivery.
Ascent supplies the opposing vertical vector and places revelation within a complete directional field.

structural_cues: 34:2 balances entering with exiting and descending with ascending; 34:6 retains descent and immediately adds guidance to a path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired boundary motions and the focus supplies descent followed by route-guidance; I infer that delivery is translated into human movement. A live alternative is that 34:2 only catalogs divine knowledge and does not imply a return trajectory for the guided person.

changed_reading.before: Revelation simply comes down from a higher source and then contains directions.
changed_reading.after: The delivered disclosure enters a world of coordinated boundary crossings and converts its vertical arrival into a traversable human orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mocking speakers offer to point toward a report-giver, but the later challenge is to see the entire field before and behind as a sign. With the supplied mark-reading branches, focus knowledge becomes disciplined literacy in indications: the knowledgeable recognize the disclosure because its truth coheres with an already marked field.

activation_trace.role: Outer or inward vision anchors recognition in an act of seeing.
A distinguishing mark that leads to its referent supplies the focus capacity being activated.
Pointing something out by an indication supplies the mockers' competing act of direction.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the contested object the mockers reduce to hearsay.
The repeated demand for sight turns the focus seeing into a failed or successful reading practice.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible mark indicating a condition makes the surrounding sky legible as evidence.
An evident sign supplies the unit that informed sight must recognize.
Repeated return supplies the receptive motion that turns surrounding signs into correction rather than spectacle.

structural_cues: 34:7 frames guidance as sarcastic pointing to a man with a report; 34:9 answers with a seeing question spanning what lies before and behind and closes with a sign for a returning servant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, indication, sign, return, and a split sky-to-mark inventory; I infer that knowledge in 34:6 is competence in reading a marked environment. The alternative is a simpler contrast between belief and disbelief with no technical account of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Those given knowledge possess information that lets them approve the message.
changed_reading.after: Those given knowledge can read indications across the surrounding field, distinguish a conveyed report from mockery, and recognize the revelation as the same truth-bearing waymark system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Saba sequence materializes a path as a network of proportioned stages: travel is measured and safe, but a demand for greater distance is followed by communal tearing and conversion into reports. Gratitude maintains the relation between provision and passage; rejection deforms a usable corridor into separation.

activation_trace.role: The straight road anchors the contextual infrastructure model in the focus path.
Praise and gratitude supply the fitting response to a route experienced as provision.
Matching a thing to its proper measure and middle bound supplies the route's proportioned staging.
Ongoing passage supplies the enacted use of the measured corridor.
Settled security and trust supply the condition produced by traversable stages.
Actively producing distance supplies the requested deformation of the route.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the route network's social and spatial failure state.
Recognition of benefit and praise of its giver supplies the disposition that preserves passage as gift.

structural_cues: 34:18 places visible settlements, measured travel, nights and days, and security in one instruction; 34:19 requests widened journeys and then repeats total tearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured secure travel, requested distance, and subsequent fragmentation; I infer a causal route-maintenance model in which proportion and gratitude preserve connectivity. The live alternative is that the sequence concerns economic ingratitude without directly modeling the focus path.

changed_reading.before: The path of the Mighty and Praiseworthy is an abstract moral line.
changed_reading.after: The path is a maintained corridor of proportionate, visible stages whose safety is realized through grateful travel; chosen remoteness can shatter both corridor and community.

context_deltas.mechanism: Conjecture becomes socially followed, doubt interpenetrates alternatives, and the Lord later opens the dispute by truth. The focus truth therefore acts not only as correct content but as the criterion that unlocks and separates rival claims, locating agents on guidance or in error.

activation_trace.role: Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the focus criterion's operative rather than merely descriptive force.
Direction toward truth and road supplies the position produced by a valid criterion.
Unsettled imagining supplies the weak epistemic input that can nevertheless organize behavior.
Following in another's track supplies the social propagation of conjecture.
Interpenetrating alternatives that prevent certainty supply the blocked state requiring judgment.
Opening what is closed by judgment supplies the act that resolves the blocked dispute.
Manifest establishment of truth supplies the instrument by which the adjudicative opening occurs.

structural_cues: 34:24 places the two parties either upon guidance or inside manifest error; 34:26 gathers them and opens between them by truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies followed conjecture, doubt, opposed positions, gathering, and judicial opening by truth; I infer that truth in 34:6 is an active separator of claims. The alternative is that the later opening is exclusively future judgment and does not describe present recognition.

changed_reading.before: Truth names the accurate proposition recognized by experts.
changed_reading.after: Truth is an operative criterion that opens a blocked dispute, separates inherited conjecture from warranted sight, and places the knower on a viable course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later dialogue distinguishes arrival from traversal: guidance comes, yet status-bearing leaders can turn dependents away from it. Focus knowledge is therefore not a credential aligned with rank; it is a received capacity that must resist social diversion after disclosure has arrived.

activation_trace.role: Being given knowledge anchors epistemic capacity in reception rather than status production.
Gentle direction toward the road supplies the guidance whose social passage is at issue.
Lack of power supplies the dependent position vulnerable to another group's direction.
Elevated rank and leadership supply the authority position capable of controlling reception.
Turning away and diverting supplies the explicit mechanism by which a route can be blocked.
Direction toward truth and road identifies the precise object from which people were diverted.
Arrival supplies the key temporal fact that access preceded obstruction.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stages reciprocal accusations between the socially weakened and elevated; 34:32 explicitly locates diversion after guidance had arrived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hierarchy, diversion, and prior arrival; I infer a transmission chain in which guidance can be socially intercepted. The alternative is that the dialogue allocates blame without changing the focus account of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Once revelation guides, informed hearers naturally follow its path.
changed_reading.after: Arrival does not guarantee traversal: those truly given knowledge are marked by resistance to power-mediated diversion, while rank and dependence can interrupt guidance after it is present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to rise for God, in pairs and singly, and only then reflect supplies a procedure for the focus seeing. Paired examination tests a reading with another person; solitary examination tests it without group pressure; repeated inward turning then separates considered recognition from a claim of mental covering.

activation_trace.role: Inward opinion and deliberation supply the focus seeing as considered judgment.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the outcome sought by the later inquiry procedure.
Resolute rising toward a matter supplies the accountable first step before reflection.
Joining one person to one other supplies the interpersonal testing condition.
The isolated one supplies the independent testing condition.
The heart's repeated movement through a matter supplies the culminating deliberative act.
Covering of reason supplies the rejected rival account of the messenger and clarifies what disciplined reflection must test.

structural_cues: The sequencing particle in 34:46 places standing before reflection, and the paired/single alternatives span social and solitary examination before rejecting the madness charge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered inquiry in paired and solitary modes; I infer that the two modes function as checks on conformity and private distortion. A live alternative is that they only intensify sincerity, without prescribing an epistemic method.

changed_reading.before: The knowledgeable simply possess a settled intuition that the disclosure is true.
changed_reading.after: Their seeing can be reconstructed as accountable inquiry: take a principled stand, test the matter both interpersonally and alone, then let the heart work repeatedly until recognition becomes knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late sequence gives truth kinetic phases: it is cast, arrives, and leaves falsehood unable to initiate or recur; guidance is then explicitly attributed to what the Lord reveals. This resolves the focus sequence toward an active subject: the delivered truth does not merely describe the path but exerts directional force.

activation_trace.role: Delivery of the disclosure anchors the later kinetic sequence in the focus object.
Direction toward truth and road supplies the active effect whose source the context clarifies.
Forceful casting supplies propulsion rather than static possession of truth.
Manifest establishment supplies what the propelled truth accomplishes on arrival.
Coming and obtaining presence supply the arrival phase of truth's motion.
Loss of useful operation supplies falsehood's disabled state after truth arrives.
Return after departure supplies the recurrence explicitly denied to falsehood.
The repeated guidance root links the focus predicate directly to the later causal statement.
A concealed imparting of knowledge supplies the stated means by which the speaker is guided.

structural_cues: 34:48-50 sequences casting truth, truth's arrival, falsehood's inability to begin or return, and guidance by what the Lord reveals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, casting, arrival, disabled falsehood, and explicit guidance by revelation; I infer that these are phases of one revelatory agency. The alternative is that the kinetic verbs are separate rhetorical images and leave the subject of the focus guidance predicate open.

changed_reading.before: Revelation contains true guidance that a knowledgeable person may extract.
changed_reading.after: Revealed truth is mobile agency: delivered, propelled, and arrived, it disables falsehood's production and recurrence while itself causing orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close opposes near seizure to attempted grasp from far away and ends with a barrier between people and desire. The focus path is therefore temporal as well as spatial: guidance offers a presently reachable corridor, but prolonged destabilizing doubt converts nearness into missed access and separation.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward a road anchors the model in available guidance.
The straight road supplies the corridor whose accessibility changes over time.
Failure of apprehension and access supplies the terminal state of missed guidance.
Nearness supplies the paradoxical location from which seizure is unavoidable.
Stretching to grasp and reach supplies the belated attempt to obtain faith.
Distance from nearness supplies why the attempted grasp can no longer succeed.
An interposed barrier supplies the closure of the once traversable corridor.
Agitated doubt supplies the prolonged epistemic state preceding loss of access.

structural_cues: 34:51-54 moves from no escape and seizure from a near place, to failed grasp from a far place, to a barrier between people and what they desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near/far polarity, failed reaching, and final separation; I infer that the focus path has a time-sensitive accessibility window. The alternative is that the close describes only final punishment, without modifying the present semantics of guidance.

changed_reading.before: The path is a permanently available correct line that can be acknowledged whenever one chooses.
changed_reading.after: The path is a reachable corridor offered in the present; doubt and delay can turn access into distance until recognition becomes a grasp attempted across an impassable barrier.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers an armor-making mechanism into discourse. It remains anchored in the focus branch of truth as tightly woven speech and in the focus image of solidity, with immediate context supplying softened iron and calibrated links. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for coherent, protective guidance, not as a lexical gloss of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Truth at focus word 11, the path at word 14, and the strength epithet at word 15.

activation_trace.role: Tightly woven, well-formed speech supplies the discourse-side anchor for a protective fabric model.
Compact and resistant material supplies the resilience associated with the route's strength.
Softness opposed to rough hardness supplies the malleability required before shaping.
Iron and resistant hardness supply the raw protective medium.
Fitting each part to its proper proportion supplies calibration of the whole.
Piercing and linking rings supplies the interlocked structure that converts pieces into protection.

changed_reading.before: Truth is coherent speech that points toward a strong path.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the disclosure is a measured interlocking discourse: its calibrated joints turn truthful speech into protective, resilient guidance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant r-w-y target beneath the surface seeing verb and shifts reception toward transmission. It remains packet-valid through that supplied split inventory and the neighboring report and made-into-stories roots. Downstream prose should label it a wordplay-like exploratory layer, never the primary morphology of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus seeing verb at word 1 under its supplied non-dominant mapped target, together with the knowledge and guidance sequence.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of report or verse supplies an exploratory second life for seeing as carrying what has been recognized.
Knowledge as disclosed recognition keeps transmission dependent on prior understanding.
An arriving, conveyed report supplies the contested transmission that follows the focus.
Becoming the subject of people's reports supplies the negative end-state of a community that failed to carry guidance coherently.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the contrast between coherent transmission and fragmented after-story.

changed_reading.before: The knowledgeable only perceive the revelation's truth for themselves.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recognition also commissions coherent transmission: those who know carry the guiding report, whereas refusal ends in fragmentation and being carried merely as cautionary stories.

strongest_changes: Knowledge became sign-literacy and an accountable practice of reflection, not merely a credential.
The path became a measured, socially vulnerable, and time-limited corridor rather than an abstract line.
Truth became an adjudicating and mobile agency that arrives, disables falsehood, and causes orientation.
The Saba route and the final near/far sequence made grateful traversal and timely access integral to the focus claim.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly rendered the focus's epistemic vocabulary in spatial and material mechanisms: marks form a legible field, proportioned stages form a safe route, measured links form a protective weave, and near/far relations determine whether guidance can still be reached.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammatical subject of the focus guidance predicate may be the delivered disclosure, truth, or an implicitly continued divine agent; 34:50 strongly favors revelation as means without fully closing the syntax.
The marked-field reading partly depends on the supplied non-dominant mapping from the sky root to a marking root, so it remains medium rather than strong.
The measured-route and armor readings transfer contextual mechanisms into the focus; they should not be presented as direct lexical equivalences.
